tasks.label: adb reverse 8080
tasks.command: $adb = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe"; & $adb devices | Select-String '\tdevice$' | ForEach-Object { $id = ($_ -split '\t')[0]; if ($id -notlike 'emulator-*') { & $adb -s $id reverse tcp:8080 tcp:8080; Write-Host "reverse 8080 -> $id" } }
